subject.facility_name: Southport Center For Nursing & Rehabilitation Llc

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $143.32 per resident day (37.7% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 6.3% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $259,710, 4.4% of the $5,902,731 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $958,205, $23.26 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $446,695 (46.6%), allocated fringe $152,408 (15.9%), non-wage costs $359,102 (37.5%). Raw food was $306,908 ($7.45 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $638.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $657,569, $15.97 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $459,098 (69.8%), allocated fringe $156,640 (23.8%), non-wage costs $41,831 (6.4%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $335,620, $8.15 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $144,072 (42.9%), allocated fringe $49,156 (14.6%), non-wage costs $142,392 (42.4%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2018 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
